name: 3731-eagledecode-llama2-7b-1gpu
model: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf with the EAGLE draft head lmsys/sglang-EAGLE-llama2-chat-7B. The target repo is gated -- request access before running; the draft repo is not.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
parallelism: tp1. No tensor, pipeline, expert or data parallelism.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 800 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text` over `/v1/completions`, single turn: one shared 650-token preamble (prefix_count 1, so it is byte-identical across the run) followed by a private question of 75 +- 25 tokens (clamped 32-160), answered in 110 +- 30 tokens (clamped 40-220). Seed 42. The shape is a few-shot reasoning prompt.
purpose: A few-shot reasoning assistant with a 7B chat model and draft head, serving 64 concurrent short answers on one GPU.
launch:
# sglang server arguments at commit 6252ade98571c3374d7e7df3430a2bfbddfc5eb3. Flat `key: value`
# only -- an indented block is skipped when this file is read and the engine then starts without
# the mechanism it declares. host / port / served-model-name are set at launch.

model-path: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf
tp-size: 1

# The draft head is trained for this exact target; the three numbers set the proposal tree.
speculative-algorithm: EAGLE
speculative-draft-model-path: lmsys/sglang-EAGLE-llama2-chat-7B
speculative-num-steps: 2
speculative-eagle-topk: 4
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 4

# Declared, not defaulted: this build's default backend is FlashInfer.
attention-backend: triton

# No prefix sharing. The engine force-disables the radix cache under EAGLE anyway, along with
# chunked prefill and cuda-graph padding -- do not add those as keys.
disable-radix-cache: true

# The model's own trained window. The longest draw here is 650 + 160 + 220 = 1030 tokens.
context-length: 4096

# Below this build's tp1 default of 0.88: two models are resident and the draft worker sizes its
# own KV pool from the target's rather than from a profile.
mem-fraction-static: 0.85

random-seed: 42
